description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator, which serves as a decorator for other definition cache objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It provides methods to decorate, copy, and delegate cache operations such as add, set, replace, get, remove, flush, and cleanup.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator
classes.description: A decorator class for HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache objects, providing a layer of abstraction to extend or modify cache behaviors without altering the underlying cache implementation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the decorator class; initializes a new decorator instance.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a new decorated cache object that references an existing cache, maintaining a link for modifications.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the decorator, acting as a clone or copy of the current decorator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Delegates the add operation to the decorated cache object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Delegates the set operation to the decorated cache object.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Delegates the replace operation to the decorated cache object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data from the decorated cache based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes data from the cache based on the configuration.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears or resets the cache for the given configuration.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup activities on the cache, such as removing expired entries.
